# sebaro Guide

> The design guide of every sebaro app, website, web app and desktop app: the 31 core rules, one blueprint and starter per product kind, components and data display. German UI language (du).

Machine-readable rules: https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/rules.json · Agent entry: https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Building a product

- [Core rules](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/design/KERN.md) and [view types](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/design/views.md): the 31 rules and 21 view types to read before any UI work
- [Playbooks](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/skills/sebaro/SKILL.md): start a new product or convert an existing project, as an agent skill
- [Agent snippet](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/templates/AGENTS-snippet.md): five lines to paste into the product's AGENTS.md
- [Starters](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/templates/README.md): website (Astro), web app (Vite), desktop (Tauri), Android (Compose); each README lists what the starter itself does not do yet
- [Screen checklist](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/templates/screen-checklist.md): walk it before a screen is done; record every check in CHECKS.md (TEC-06)
- [Agent test 2026-10](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-guide/blob/main/docs/agenten-test-2026-10.md): the rules agents missed most (TEC-06, TXT-04 U+00A0, EBE-05, BEL-10, NAV-06) and why

## Pages

- [Start](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/index.html): Einstieg: was sebaro ist, die 31 Kernregeln auf Deutsch, die Baupläne und Startvorlagen je Produktart
- [Bauteile](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/bauteile.html): Alle Komponenten mit Zuständen und Markup
- [Daten](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/daten.html): Jede Datenart einmal dargestellt: Text, Zahlen, Zeit, Status, Listen, Tabellen, Diagramme, Code …

## System files (generated, never edit)

- [tokens.css](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/sebaro/tokens.css): every --sb-* custom property, light and dark
- [sebaro.css](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/sebaro/css/sebaro.css): reference components (sb-*)
- [sprite.svg](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/sebaro/icons/sprite.svg): icon sprite
- [fonts.css](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-guide/sebaro/fonts/fonts.css): self-hosted sebaro Sans + sebaro Mono
